authority: Maintainer approved the proposed auxiliary-independent EEG test: appproved, lets do it keep going and finding ways to get better breakthrough results; standing charter Tier B
target: Five-word development calibration labels; all 600 original trials, three people, both conditions, no exclusions
hypothesis: Recorded EEG processed without peripheral input adds predictive association beyond both the original auxiliary readout and a repetition-resolved auxiliary readout; fixed marginal frequency and repetition-position views characterize any association without winner selection
eeg_preprocessing: Same source EEG gain, EEG-only notch50/100, EEG-only CAR, independent per-channel2-118Hz bandpass on1626samples; per-channel float64 z-score over full1626samples, std(ddof1)+float64epsilon. No adaptive_residual, NLMS, sham template, auxiliary-derived scale or fitted auxiliary-to-EEG transform. Crop25:1625 and castfloat32 before float64 spectral calculation.

auxiliary.N: Unchanged392columns: five conventionally filtered bipolar auxiliary channels with78features each, then original trial index and elapsed time at390:392
auxiliary.A: 692columns: originalN392, then150raw auxiliary per-repetition log bandpowers, then150normalized auxiliary per-repetition log bandpowers. Normalize auxiliary channels independently over the same full1626sample window (ddof1+epsilon), not per-repetition. Crop25:1625float32; each150block flattens5channels x5repetitions x6bands in that order. No recordedEEG sample or statistic enters auxiliary features.
auxiliary.caveat: Enrichment is not guaranteed to improve prediction. A is standardized as one692featureblock, so dimension normalization differs from N; both A and unchanged N remain required comparators. Joint derangement matches each joint model's feature count.

spectral_settings: Five320sample repetitions at256Hz. Same one-sided squared FFT/320^2, interior bins doubled, no taper; bands2-4,4-8,8-13,13-30,30-60,60-118Hz with118included. EEG view averages selected repetition powers thenlogs, notmeanlog. Auxiliary enrichment retains separate per-repetition log powers.

views.full_all: All five repetitions, all six bands,128x6=768features; primary
views.early_all: First two complete repetitions only, all six bands,768features
views.late_all: Last two complete repetitions only, all six bands,768features

temporal_limit: Early/late are repetition-position comparisons inside the same action window, not pre-cue, pre-action, causal, or independent temporal-localization controls. Whole-buffer filtering and normalization are noncausal and shared across the selected positions. All original trials are retained in every view.
arms: 51total: N,N_shuffled,A,A_shuffled,uniform,training_prior; for each nine EEG views R: R,R_shuffled,A_R,A_R_deranged,A_R_shuffled. All arms reported under both schemes.
model: Unchanged one-hot ridge alpha1, unpenalized intercept, softmax, no tuning or probability calibration. Each N/A/EEG featureblock centered/scaled on trainingrows only and divided bysqrt(own dimension). Joint A and EEG are separately scaled. Single-band versus all-band differences also change feature count and regularization geometry; do not infer unique physiological information from rankings.
split_algorithms: Unchanged blocked_embargo1 primary: five chronological20trialblocks, one adjacent trainingtrial embargo perboundary,78/79trainingtrials. Unchanged stratified_shuffled secondary: StratifiedKFold5 shuffleTrue random_state20260921,80trainingtrials. Retrospective within-recording, not past-to-future. All five repetitions of each trial remain together. All six class-support and split-hash preflights before any fit.
label_shuffle: Training labels only; seed20260921+100*scheme_index+fold_index, same permutation across all arms in a fold; no validation target enters fitting
derangement: One-position EEG feature-row cyclic shift separately within train and validation, A aligned; scale on original trainingrows before the shift. No crossfold donors. Misalignment diagnostic, not calibrated permutation inference.
primary_metric: Class-macro log loss pooled over100original out-of-fold trials perperson; equal-person descriptive means; balanced accuracy secondary
threshold: Primary log loss strictly lower than each of six comparators in all three people within a condition under blockedvalidation; both conditions separately. Descriptive consistency, not statistical significance.
exploratory_views: For every view report the same six-comparator gains (own derangement/shuffle) plus joint log-loss gain versus full_all. Preserve all nine views. No best-band/window selection, no substitution for a failed primary, no multiplicity-adjusted or confirmatory claim. A view-consistent signal is only a hypothesis for independent testing.

interpretation.primary_pass: Incremental predictive association from recorded EEG under auxiliary-independent preprocessing beyond these fixed peripheral readouts; not cortical origin or cue-independent communication
interpretation.A_improves_N: Useful refinement of auxiliary prediction; does not establish physiological origin, silence, or online utility
interpretation.views_only_pass: Exploratory heterogeneity requiring independent testing, not rescue of the primary or selection of a future winner on consumed evaluation
interpretation.random_only: Sensitive to temporal split structure; blocked criterion fails
interpretation.null: No demonstrated increment for these fixed EEG representations; do not escalate model complexity on this evidence or conclude EEG lacks useful information

stop_rule: One invocation after generated checks and both remote CI jobs pass. Preserve failures; no automatic retry, dropped trial or partial aggregate. Scientific code unchanged during execution. Stream trials, no retained waveform/feature cache. All four previous scientific result aggregates remain byte-identical.
forbidden: old private targets, predictions or weights

claim_coordinates.attribution: association beyond fixed recorded auxiliary models, not cortical origin
